summary: Completed comprehensive testing of LATO SEGRETO admin workflow iteration: filters, counts, demo/real detection with manual override, readiness checklist, publish blocking, copy-config, import rapido, draft preview, and public site regression. All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend UI fully functional with all new admin features.
passed_tests: Backend: Admin login successful
Backend: GET /api/admin/models returns counts (tutte=10, demo=10, reali=0, incomplete=0, pronte=0)
Backend: Items have content_status (is_demo, demo_fields), readiness (is_ready, missing_count, missing_required), stato_operativo
Backend: Publish blocking works - PATCH stato=pubblicata returns HTTP 400 with structured error (message='NON PUOI ANCORA PUBBLICARE', missing_required array, missing_count)
Backend: Manual override works - content_overrides forces is_demo=False even with demo URLs
Backend: Readiness detection works - found complete model with is_ready=true, missing_count=0
Backend: Copy-config endpoint works - copies tema/regia/cta_temporizzata/pellicola but NOT bio/foto_card/onlyfans
Backend: Draft preview works - 404 without auth, 200 with admin token + anteprima=true for both /api/models/{slug} and /api/models/{slug}/segreto
Backend: Regression tests pass - /api/models, /api/pellicola, /api/categories, /api/admin/me all return 200
Frontend: Admin login successful
Frontend: Models list shows counts display (TUTTE, DEMO, REALI, INCOMPLETE, PRONTE)
Frontend: All 5 filters work (tutte, demo, reali, incomplete, pronte)
Frontend: Model rows show content badges (DEMO/REALE) and operational state badges (PUBBLICATA/PRONTA/INCOMPLETA)
Frontend: Model editor shows checklist panel with 16 items and ready/notready badge
Frontend: Model editor has 16 override selectors (Automatico/Demo/Reale) for media fields
Frontend: Import Rapido modal opens, accepts URL input, creates assets with slot assignment
Frontend: Copy config section present with select and button
Frontend: Preview button present for existing models
Frontend: Incomplete model creation shows checklist with missing required fields
Frontend: Public home page loads correctly
Frontend: Pellicola 'IN MOVIMENTO' section visible
Frontend: Model cards display (10 found)
Frontend: Model profile loads with secret mode indicator showing 'LATO PUBBLICO'
Frontend: Secret trigger button present with correct text 'NON DOVRESTI PREMERLO'
Frontend: Media grid displays correctly
Frontend: Secret transformation works - clicking trigger changes mode to 'LATO SEGRETO'
Frontend: Secret ambience effects visible (purple/bordeaux theme)
Frontend: Revert button works - returns to 'LATO PUBBLICO' mode
